target.title: feat(ui): scroll truncated sidebar session names on hover
target.body:
## What Problem This Solves

Long session titles in the Control UI sidebar's recent-sessions list get clipped with an ellipsis, and there is no way to read the hidden tail without opening the session or waiting for the native tooltip. Titles like "Fix stale iMessage group-allowlist warning copy" become indistinguishable once several sessions share a prefix.

## Why This Change Was Made

Hovering a session row now animates the truncated label so the clipped tail scrolls into view (marquee-style), and the label snaps back quickly when the pointer leaves. The animation transitions `text-indent` rather than transforming an inner wrapper because `text-overflow` renders no ellipsis for atomic inline children — the wrapper approach would have lost the resting "…". Scroll duration is proportional to the hidden distance (80px/s, 300ms minimum) so short and long titles both stay readable, labels that fit are left untouched, and `prefers-reduced-motion` keeps the static ellipsis. The helper (`ui/src/lib/hover-marquee.ts`) plus generic `.hover-marquee` CSS are reusable for other truncated labels (e.g. the sessions table or session picker) as follow-ups; this PR wires only the requested sidebar surface.

## User Impact

Hovering a truncated session name in the sidebar scrolls the full title into view; moving the mouse away restores the normal ellipsized label. No behavior change for labels that fit, keyboard users, or reduced-motion users.

## Evidence

- Rest (ellipsis preserved): ![rest](https://github.com/steipete/openclaw-pr-assets/releases/download/sidebar-hover-marquee/marquee-rest.png)
- Mid-scroll on hover: ![mid](https://github.com/steipete/openclaw-pr-assets/releases/download/sidebar-hover-marquee/marquee-mid.png)
- End of scroll (tail fully readable): ![end](https://github.com/steipete/openclaw-pr-assets/releases/download/sidebar-hover-marquee/marquee-end.png)
- `pnpm test ui/src/lib/hover-marquee.test.ts ui/src/lib/hover-marquee.browser.test.ts` — 6/6 passed, including a real-Chromium round-trip asserting the computed `text-indent` reaches the measured overflow on hover and returns to 0 on leave.
- `pnpm check:changed` — passed on Blacksmith Testbox `tbx_01kwrw6shvt8x77pccmbv6bstd` (exit 0).
- Codex autoreview (`gpt-5.5`): clean, no accepted findings.
